note: Made by the 2026-11 monthly run under the earlier per-shot plan (Nano Banana Pro keyframes + Kling 4.0 clips, one shot per old shotlist entry). The plan switched to Seedance 2.5 beat plans while this run was in progress, so these are kept here as a reusable library: the README says to reuse an existing shot wherever it fits. All keyframes and clips passed the depiction check. Shots v01-ep07-s03 to v01-ep08-s06 have a keyframe only (no clip). Episode texts for ep06-ep10 were not in the project PDF; those briefs follow the shot notes and the standard Seerah account.

shots.note: the family, the belt, the journey
shots.scene: A long empty desert road through rocky hills at dawn, heading south toward distant dark mountains. In the sand: a line of fresh camel tracks and beside them a faint smooth drag line where a trailing cloth belt has brushed the footprints away. Vast quiet journey, warm dust in the air.

shots.note: set down by the tree at the place of the House; no one, no water
shots.scene: A barren, empty valley between bare dark mountains: no water, no plants, no people. A single small thorny tree stands near a low reddish mound of earth where a sacred house will one day stand. A small bundle of cloth and a leather bag rest in the tree's shade.

Close still life in the shade of a thorny desert tree: a small woven palm-leaf bag of dates spilling a few dates onto a cloth, and a leather waterskin beside it, half full, resting on warm sand. Empty valley softly blurred behind.

shots.note: he turns and walks; she follows
shots.scene: Fresh sandal footprints in the sand leading away from a lone tree toward a mountain pass, and a second, smaller line of footprints following a short way behind them then stopping. Low sun, long shadows of rocks only.

shots.note: the pass where they cannot see him
shots.scene: A narrow rocky mountain pass at the edge of a valley, seen from inside the pass looking back: the empty valley below is hidden behind a bend of rock. Quiet, solemn, late afternoon light on the stones.
Point of view from a high rocky pass looking down toward a vast barren valley, sky glowing with warm light, a feeling of prayer and stillness; rays of sunlight falling into the empty valley.

The empty valley at dusk turning to night, a lone thorny tree, a small cloth shelter tied to its branches, a tiny fading campfire glow, enormous starry sky above bare mountains. Loneliness and quiet trust.

shots.note: nursing her son, drinking the water
shots.scene: Under a lone thorny tree in a barren valley: a woven cradle cloth gently tucked in the shade, an open leather waterskin and a few dates on a cloth beside it. Tender, quiet morning light.
Extreme close-up of an empty, crumpled leather waterskin lying on cracked dry earth under a harsh noon sun, heat haze over the barren valley behind.
The rocky hilltop of Safa in an empty ancient valley, viewed from its summit looking out across a barren plain toward the far hill of Marwa, searching for any sign of life; harsh bright light.

Low-angle view of the dusty valley floor between two rocky hills, Safa and Marwa, with a trail of hurried fresh footprints running back and forth between them, dust still hanging in the air. Hot shimmering light.
The rocky hilltop of Marwa in late afternoon: complete stillness, a hush over the valley, warm wind lifting fine sand off the rocks, a soft glow in the air as if a voice has just been heard.

shots.note: the angel at Zamzam, the basin
shots.scene: Pure clear water bubbling up from the dry sand of the valley floor, a small basin of piled sand and stones holding it, sunlight sparkling on the water, a soft column of warm light falling from above onto the spring. No figures of any kind, no wings.

shots.note: the angel's words; the site of the House
shots.scene: A soft beam of warm light falling onto a low reddish mound in the barren valley where a sacred house will be built, a newly sprung spring glittering nearby. Sense of promise. No figures of any kind, no wings.
A caravan of the Jurhum tribe crossing desert hills: men in turbans on camels, laden pack animals, looking up at a bird circling in the sky over a distant valley, a sign of water.

Goat-hair tents of the Jurhum tribe pitched around a small spring in a valley between dark mountains, camels resting, smoke rising from cooking fires, men drawing water, a new settlement forming at golden hour.

A busy Jurhum tent settlement in a mountain valley years later: palms planted, goats grazing, grown men talking around a fire, distant women at the spring, wide view with no single figure in focus and no children. Life has grown around the water.

shots.note: first visit; hardship; change the threshold
shots.scene: The doorway of a simple, worn tent in a poor Jurhum settlement at dusk: a cracked wooden threshold beam, an empty cooking pot, a dim lamp, a hard and meagre life. Empty doorway.

shots.note: second visit; meat and water; keep the threshold
shots.scene: The doorway of a well-kept, welcoming tent at golden hour: a solid wooden threshold beam, a platter of cooked meat and a jug of water set out for a guest, warm lamp light. Empty doorway.

shots.note: Isma'il shaping arrows under the tree near Zamzam
shots.scene: Under a large tree near a stone-rimmed spring: a craftsman's spot with freshly shaped wooden arrow shafts, feathers, a bow and a small knife laid on a leather mat, wood shavings in the sand. Nobody present.

shots.note: the raised mound where the House will stand
shots.scene: A gently raised reddish mound of earth in the middle of a valley ringed by mountains, a spring nearby, warm light singling it out as the place where a sacred house will stand.

Foundations of an ancient rectangular stone house being raised: rough dark stones laid course upon course, more stones stacked nearby carried down from the mountains, mortar of mud, dust in the warm air. No people visible, only the work.
Close-up of a single flat stone set at the foot of a half-built stone wall, softly lit, smooth worn surface, fine dust drifting across it.

shots.note: building and going round the House
shots.scene: A simple cube-shaped stone house standing complete at dusk in a quiet valley, warm sunset light on its rough dark stones, a well-trodden circular path around it in the sand.
The finished cube-shaped house of rough dark stone stands alone in the valley at golden hour, mountains behind, a peaceful sacred calm.

shots.note: make this land secure; teach us our rites
shots.scene: A peaceful valley around the stone house: doves resting on the stones, gazelles grazing safely nearby, a sense of security and sanctuary; warm light.
The stone house under an immense starry night sky, the Milky Way above the mountains, a feeling of prayer rising to heaven.

shots.note: proclaim the pilgrimage; people come from every place
shots.scene: Long lines of distant pilgrims on camels and on foot converging from mountain passes in every direction toward a small stone house in a valley; seen from very high and far away, tiny figures.
Time passing over the valley: the stone house and growing settlement, palms, tents turning to mud-brick houses, seasons of light sweeping across. Wide establishing shot.
A radiant soft light breaking over the mountains behind the stone house, like a promised dawn. Abstract, hopeful, golden. No figures of any kind.
Wind blowing sand over old footpaths around the stone house at dusk, the valley quiet, a sense of a memory being forgotten.

shots.note: the valley too small for them
shots.scene: An overcrowded valley settlement: tents and mud-brick houses packed tightly together, herds jostling at the water, arguments, families loading camels to leave in search of new land.

shots.note: carrying a stone of the Sanctuary
shots.scene: Departing families on camels leaving the valley, one man carefully carrying a stone from the sanctuary wrapped in cloth, looking back at the valley.

shots.note: setting the stone down and circling it
shots.scene: In a new desert camp, a group of travellers have set down a sanctuary stone on the ground and walk in a slow circle around it, reverent, dusty light. Women in the group fully covered.
Amr ibn Luhayy, a wealthy Arab chief in rich robes, standing in a Syrian town with Roman-era columns, watching townspeople venerate stone statues; he looks impressed.
A large red carnelian stone idol of a man with a broken right hand replaced by a golden hand, standing inside a dim stone chamber lit by oil lamps. Ominous.

shots.note: idols around the House; the altered talbiya
shots.scene: Many stone and wooden idols placed around a simple cube-shaped stone house in a valley, crowds of pilgrims circling, smoke of offerings, a corrupted atmosphere.
Soft warm light falling through a quiet palm grove onto empty ground, a reflective, solemn mood. No figures of any kind.
The cube-shaped stone house at night crowded around with dozens of idols of stone and wood, torches flickering, heavy dark mood.
The cube-shaped stone house at night, surrounded by idols, torches, guarded by men of the Khuza'a tribe; years of their control over Mecca.
A band of riders on horses and camels led by a determined young chief, Qusayy, galloping across desert hills toward Mecca, banners of cloth, dust plumes.
Qusayy gathering the scattered clans of Quraysh into the valley of Mecca: families arriving with tents and camels, men laying out plots for houses around the stone house.
A determined chief, Qusayy, swinging an axe at a tree in a valley while hesitant men watch, clearing ground to build houses near the sanctuary.
Close-up of a heavy old iron key to the door of the sacred house being passed from one man's hand to another's, warm light.
Dar al-Nadwa: a stone council hall with a courtyard, tribal elders in turbans and cloaks seated in a circle on mats, debating, Qusayy presiding.
The stone council house of Mecca at night, oil lamps glowing in its doorway, the sacred house silhouetted nearby under the stars.
A forgotten patch of sand and rubble between idols near the stone house, where an ancient well lies buried and lost; dry, abandoned.
Abd al-Muttalib, a dignified older Meccan chief with a white beard, sleeping on a mat in a low semicircular stone enclosure beside the sacred house at night, as if dreaming.
A black crow pecking at the ground between two stone idols near the sacred house, marking a spot in the sand; morning light.
Abd al-Muttalib and his young son al-Harith digging with a pickaxe and a basket at a spot near the sacred house, Quraysh men watching sceptically.
A small caravan of Quraysh men crossing an endless desert under a merciless sun, waterskins empty, camels exhausted.
Thirsty men in the desert each digging a shallow pit beside their kneeling camels, expecting death, grim faces, harsh light.
Fresh water bursting up from the sand beneath the hoof of a kneeling camel, Abd al-Muttalib and the thirsty men crying out in joy.
The rediscovered well of Zamzam near the sacred house: a stone-rimmed well with water drawn up in leather buckets, pilgrims drinking.
Abd al-Muttalib standing alone by the sacred house at night, hands raised in a vow, torchlight on his face.
Close-up of a set of divining arrows in a leather quiver held by an idol keeper, lamp light, inside a shrine.
The red carnelian idol Hubal with its golden hand inside the sacred house, men gathered before it with divining arrows, tense lamp-lit mood.
Abd al-Muttalib leading his young son Abdullah by the hand toward the sanctuary, a knife at his belt, Quraysh men rushing to stop him.
A small herd of ten camels standing before the sacred house, Quraysh men watching the casting of arrows.
One hundred camels filling the valley around the sacred house at golden hour, Abd al-Muttalib relieved, his son Abdullah spared, crowds cheering.
